limitations_noted: Shared candidate structure: All 8 candidates follow a two-employment chronological template without independent project records, reflecting generator scenario constraints documented in HR-SOURCE-009.

Degree level terminology: Candidate MK-J01-C04 retains 'Cử nhân Cao đẳng' verbatim in education.degree and MK-J01-C04-SEC-EDU under HR-SOURCE-010 without forced mapping to university or college level.

Tenure duration ambiguities: Candidates C01, C02, C03, C04, C05, C07, and C08 state summary tenures reflecting specific domain experience or rounded duration rather than exact arithmetic sum across all roles; C07 includes a prior freelance role with unstated start/end dates (is_current: false explicitly supported by 'trước đây' under HR-SOURCE-005). All tenure scopes preserved under HR-SOURCE-008.

Presence-only and bounded scope qualifiers: Support, coordination, or narrow-scope roles/tags remain preserved verbatim in descriptions and flagged for calibration (C01 Facebook page likes as Meta Ads in EXP-02 and coarse tag 'Sản xuất video ngắn và visual' for script/brief coordination in EXP-01; C02 coarse tag 'Sản xuất visual và video ngắn' for coordination with designer/videographer in EXP-01; C03 content-approval boundary and coarse 'Viết bài thông cáo báo chí' PR tag in EXP-01; C04 basic Ads Manager/GA in SKILL; C08 budget allocation coordination in EXP-01).

Fictional entity scope: All 16 employer names in MK-J01 are fictionalized and unique across all 20 pilot jobs, with media outlet names in C03 replaced by generic descriptors under HR-SOURCE-007; no external commercial register nonexistence claim asserted.
